# DSH Visualization — session instrument for DeepSeek Harness

A layered instrument for a live DSH session: a sidebar icon, a full panel showing the session's
ring
s, turns, tools and background jobs.
**English** (below) · **中文说明** at the bottom.
> The standalone version (open `standalone/start.cmd`, no DSH plugin needed) lives in `standalone/`.
- **Seven rings**: ① session · ② steps · ③ skills · ④ tools · ⑤ jobs · ⑥ approvals · ⑦ changes — eac

h one toggleable
- **Turn timeline**: two lines per turn — number + steps/tools/duration, then the p

rompt you typed
- **Connections**: per-step ladders (①→②→③→④) with dots running along them, or beams

from the core
- **Hover / click**: every node on every ring answers — hover for its name, click for

details (tools list the last six actual commands)
- **Turn scoping**: `show turns` / `line turns` k

nobs narrow the view to the last N turns
- Every display option is remembered in `localStorage`
# For users
## Requirements
- **Node ≥ 22.15** in the host: session logs are zstd-compressed. Without support the panel says so

explicitly instead of rendering blank.
- Session directory defaults to `~/.dsh/sessions`; if DSH sto

res data elsewhere, set `DSH_HOME`
or `DSHVIZ_SESSIONS_ROOT`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A ring icon appears in the left rail; click it to open the instrument.
Or from npm: pm i dsh-visualization (package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-visualization).
## Reading the panel
| Area | What it tells you |

| Centre number | current turn; `TOOL` / `THINKING` / `IDLE` above it |
| ① session ring | context-w

indow usage + the last 12 turn ticks |
| ② step ring | time buckets; thicker = more time spent in th

at slice |
| ③ skill ring | 16 slots; one lights up per loaded skill |
| ④ tool ring | composition b

y call count (or by time — see `share`) |
| ⑤ job ring | one arc per background job, length ∝ runtim

e |
| ⑥ approval ring | one tick per approval, colour = outcome |
| ⑦ change ring | one tick per fil

e change; deliverables are taller |
| Right column | session flow, context, jobs, turn timeline, too

l totals |
| Bottom | event log, grouped by turn |
Direction matters: on ②–⑦ the newest data sits at 12 o'clock and older data goes clockwise.
## The controls (bottom left)
| Control | Options |

| rings `①…⑦` | show/hide each layer; radii re-spread to fill the space |
| `spin` | slow rotation o

f ②③④ |
| `lines` | `ladders` / `beams` / `both` |
| `share` | tool ring sized by `count` or by `tim

e` |
| `line turns` | how many turns get connectors (`2` by default) |
| `show turns` | how many tur

ns every panel covers |
| `⧉ window` | open a separate window you can drag to another monitor |
| `中
/ EN` | switch language |
`line turns` can never exceed `show turns` — the connector count is clamped automatically.
## Language

The UI ships in Chinese and English. It starts from `navigator.language`, remembers your choice,
and
can be forced per page with `?lang=en` / `?lang=zh`.
## When something looks wrong
| Symptom | Cause |

| Panel says "this runtime does not support zstd" | Node < 22.15 in the host |
| Panel says the sess

ion directory is empty | no session has run in this profile yet |
| Panel is empty with 403 in the n

etwork tab | you are not on loopback; set `allowRemote: true` (only on trusted machines) |
| A step
ring segment is dim and has no line | that step is outside `line turns` — raise it, or lower `show t

urns` |
| A bright segment has no line | that step made no tool calls (a text-only step) |
# For plugin developers and agents
## Files
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Editing rules (the part that bites)

1. **The page has a single source: `instrument.html`** in the repository root. Edit that, then run
`

node build.cjs`. The build only rewrites absolute endpoints (`/state` → `state`) so the page works
u

nder a path prefix. Editing `web/index.html` directly will be overwritten.
2. **Host changes need a

DSH restart.** `fold.cjs` and `index.js` are ESM modules; toggling the plugin
only remounts the rout

e — the loaded module is not re-evaluated. `client.js` and `web/*` pick up on
a page refresh.
3. **D

ebug globals are gated**: `window.__M` / `__HIT` / `__CHAIN` only exist with `?debug=1`
(or `#debug`

, or `localStorage.dshviz.debug=1`).
4. **Never rewrite the page with a one-line shell command.** It

has been destroyed that way once.
Use edits, or author a small `.cjs` patch script and run it.
## Data flow
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Cost at ~8.7k events: first fold 240–260 ms, then 7–12 ms per change. Frame parsing is exact, so a
p
artially-written tail frame simply stops the walk and is picked up next time.
## Adding things

**A new ring** — three places, all inside `instrument.html`:
`RINGVIS` / `RING_NAME` / `RING_COL` (s

tate + labels), the `if (RINGVIS[n])` drawing block in `draw()`,
and `hitReg({ kind, r, a0, a1, labe

l, data })` so hover/click works. Add a detail renderer branch in
`showDetail()` if the card needs f

a })` so hover/click works. Add a detail renderer branch in
`showDetail()` if the card needs fields.

**A new language** — `EN` map (whole-string matches), `EN_RULES` (templated phrases), `EN_FN`
(repla

cements that need logic). `LANG` currently accepts `zh` | `en`; to add a third, turn it into a
list
and key the dictionaries by code.
**A new tool kind colour** — `toolColor(name)` in `instrument.html`.
## Config
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `basePath` | `/dsh-visualization` | route prefix |
| `allowRemote` | `false` | allow non-loopback
peers. **This exposes session logs to anyone who can reach the port.** |
## Routes
| Path | Purpose |

| `/dsh-visualization/` | the page |
| `/dsh-visualization/state` | folded state, one-shot (`?sessio

n=<id>` to pin a session) |
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- **Memory grows with the session**: the reducer keeps derived state for every event. Steps/tools/lo

g are
capped; counters are cumulative. At ~100k events `result()` still sorts 1.2k steps and 1.5k to

ols,
roughly 10–20 ms per frame.
- **Two UI languages only** (zh/en).
- **Read-only**: the instrumen
t never writes session files.
